defaults.t3: Intimate editorial black and white portrait of Elena Vance, female tattoo artisan with refined features, soft studio rim lighting, wearing minimalist high-neck charcoal silk, dark studio background, luxury fashion editorial mood.
defaults.t6: Trained in classical Florentine etching, Elena translates rare botanical specimens and anatomical micro-sculptures onto skin using specialized 0.18mm surgical single-needles. Her pieces are celebrated for their ethereal transparency and lifelong soft gradient stability.
defaults.t20: High-luxury editorial macro photograph of a fine-line delicate magnolia and moth tattoo on an inner forearm. Pale obsidian and warm charcoal ink, soft depth of field, silky matte skin texture, warm brass side ambient lighting.
defaults.t23: Micro-realism tattoo of an antique pocket watch mechanism and delicate dried poppies on a human collarbone. Crisp microscopic gear details, translucent botanical petals, warm cocoa skin tones, studio luxury lighting.
defaults.t26: Close up healed fine-line tattoo of an ethereal crescent moon intertwined with ivy and nightshade berries on back shoulder blade. Soft whisper shadows, deep black and warm grey ink, editorial studio lighting.

defaults.t3: Intimate editorial portrait of Julian Thorne, male artisan with sharp tailored suit, refined silver temple accents, piercing dark eyes, studio lighting casting soft golden edge light on his silhouette.
defaults.t6: With a master's background in structural architecture, Julian crafts mathematically harmonized geometries that contour to human musculature. His signature incorporates golden-ratio mandalas, isometric perspective arches, and dot-work stippling calibrated under microscope.
defaults.t20: Photographic record of sacred geometry mandala tattooed along human spine. Ultra fine concentric circles, microscopic stippling, perfect symmetry, rich obsidian black tones against flawless skin, luxury gallery presentation.
defaults.t23: Architectural archway and isometric cube fine tattoo on outer tricep. Crisp straight lines without bleeds, subtle grey gradient wash, luxury aesthetic, dark ambient lighting.
defaults.t26: Geometric arm band composed of sacred geometry platonic solids and fine dotwork gradients. Healed rich black pigment, clean clinical photography in dark obsidian studio setting.

defaults.t3: Editorial portrait of Sora Min, Korean female master tattoo artist, minimalist sleek bob hairstyle, elegant black turtleneck, warm bronze key lighting against a deep dark espresso velvet studio backdrop.
defaults.t6: Hailing from Seoul, Sora brings meditative East Asian calligraphy brush dynamics and custom Latin typography to skin. Her single-pass technique captures ink pressure, featherweight flourishes, and bespoke heraldic monogram seals with unrivaled intimacy.
defaults.t20: Macro detail shot of ultra-fine cursive calligraphy tattoo on inner wrist. Deep black single-needle linework with dynamic ink weight mimicking real fountain pen ink flow, soft warm skin lighting.
defaults.t23: High contrast fine single needle monogram tattoo resembling luxury gold-foil serif type on upper ribcage. Razor clean edges, no redness, editorial lighting.
defaults.t26: East Asian cursive brushstroke tattoo along back of neck and spine. Sumi-e brush texture, faded ink tail ending in whisper gradient, fine aesthetic tattoo art on human skin.

defaults.t3: Moody cinematic black and white portrait of Matteo Cassel, brooding Italian master tattooist with trimmed dark beard, deep shadows, atelier atmosphere with warm rim lighting.
defaults.t6: Drawing inspiration from Caravaggio and baroque classical portraiture, Matteo creates high-contrast chiaroscuro micro-canvases. Renowned for hyper-dense blacks paired with skin-tone highlights that produce remarkable dimensional relief without scar tissue.
defaults.t20: Hyper-detailed micro-realism tattoo of Bernini's sculpture Apollo and Daphne on bicep. Dramatic shadows, silky black shading, pure white skin highlights, studio lighting.
defaults.t23: Photorealistic micro tattoo of a sleeping raven nestled against obsidian crystal facets. Deep black ink contrasts, macro skin texture, fine needle feathers.
defaults.t26: Dark surrealist tattoo of a classical Greek portrait sculpture disintegrating into geometric golden smoke. Fine shading and obsidian contrast.

notes:
## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-luxury, bespoke sanctuary for custom tattoo artistry and private salon bookings. Drawing directly from luxury cosmetic packaging, haute couture editorial layouts, and dark bespoke product design (reminiscent of the dark cocoa obsidian framing and golden foil typography in the reference material), the visual language departs entirely from gritty street shop aesthetics. It treats fine-line, blackwork, micro-realism, and ceremonial tattooing as permanent personal fine art.

### Target Audience & Emotional Intent
- **Audience:** Collectors, connoisseurs, high-net-worth creatives, and first-time luxury clients seeking private consultations, sterile clinical elegance, and world-class resident or guest artists.
- **Emotional Resonance:** Intimate, quiet confidence, reverence, meticulous hygiene, bespoke prestige, and artistic mastery.

### Design Movement: Dark Editorial Luxury & Tactile Noir
The interface utilizes an obsidian-to-espresso tonal hierarchy punctuated with warm antique bronze and satin gold leaf accents. High-contrast typography pairs stately editorial serifs with razor-sharp geometric UI primitives. Tactile cues—frosted smoked glass overlays, hairline brass borders, and rich atmospheric dark tones—frame artist portfolios and booking milestones like bespoke gallery exhibitions.

## Colors

The palette is rooted in an unyielding nocturnal spectrum that mirrors volcanic obsidian, cured dark chocolate, and hand-rubbed brass.

- **Primary (`#D4AF37` / Satin Aureolin & Warm Bronze):** Reserved for focal calls-to-action, active progress indicators, verified artist insignias, and selected date intervals. Emits subtle warmth against deep backgrounds.
- **Secondary (`#2B1E19` / Deep Roasted Cocoa):** Forms elevated card foundations, sub-navigation panels, and contextual sheets, introducing rich tactile warmth over flat black.
- **Tertiary (`#9B7E58` / Brushed Antique Ochre):** Deployed for subtle decorative keylines, caption labels, active border rings, and muted metadata.
- **Neutral (`#0D0C0B` / Obsidian Canvas):** The foundational absolute surface, absorbing harsh reflections and providing an infinitely deep gallery backdrop for portfolio imagery.

### Complementary Functional Values
- **Surface Elevation 01 (Obsidian Tint):** `#141211`
- **Surface Elevation 02 (Cocoa Smoked Glass):** `#1D1917` with 80% opacity and 16px backdrop blur
- **Text Ivory (High Contrast):** `#F6F4F0`
- **Text Muted (Warm Stone):** `#A39E98`
- **Hairline Divider / Border:** `#2E2824`

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy juxtaposes classical high-fashion editorial titles with modern architectural precision.

- **Display & Headlines (`Playfair Display`):** Delivers artisanal grace and bespoke authority. Headline treatments utilize generous vertical space and restrained tracking to invoke classic monograph title pages.
- **Body & Functional UI (`Outfit`):** Provides immaculate legibility against low-luminance backgrounds. Its geometric yet open letterforms ensure session schedules, price estimates, medical history disclosures, and consultation chats remain crisp and fatigue-free.
- **Labels & Micro-data:** Rendered in small-caps or uppercase with wide tracking (`0.12em` to `0.18em`) to mirror luxury packaging specifications (e.g., "EDITION 01", "HEALING REGIMEN", "PRIVATE SUITE").

## Layout & Spacing

Layouts follow an intentional editorial structure: ample negative breathing room, asymmetrical hero placements, and rigorous horizontal grid lines.

### Grid & Responsive Dynamics
- **Desktop (1200px+):** 12-column layout with `3rem` canvas margins and `1.5rem` gutters. Maximum content container width is capped at 1380px to preserve photographic drama without horizontal sprawl.
- **Tablet (768px - 1199px):** 8-column layout with `2rem` canvas margins and `1.25rem` gutters. Portfolio collections transition into balanced two-column masonry blocks.
- **Mobile (320px - 767px):** 4-column layout with `1.25rem` margins and `1rem` gutters. Fixed-bottom sticky interaction bars (e.g., "Reserve Session", "Request Consultation") ensure thumbs can navigate single-handed while editorial content scrolls unimpeded.

### Rhythmic Rules
- Section transitions must be delineated by generous vertical spans (`space-xxl`) or 1px hairline borders (`#2E2824`) rather than thick divider banners.
- Micro-interactions (booking step counters, artist availability pills) maintain compact internal paddings (`space-xs` to `space-sm`) to keep workflows efficient.

## Elevation & Depth

Rather than relying on drop shadows that muddy dark themes, the design system implements tactile lighting and chromatic surface tiers.

### 1. Tonal Layers
- **Level 0 (Canvas):** `#0D0C0B` — Base viewport background.
- **Level 1 (Card Bases / Lists):** `#141211` — Deep surface with fine 1px border (`#241F1C`).
- **Level 2 (Modals / Booking Sheets):** `#1B1715` — Cocoa-tinted elevated panels.
- **Level 3 (Popovers & Tooltips):** `#251E1A` — High-tier contextual overlays.

### 2. Glassmorphism & Mood Blurs
- **Smoked Glass:** Background fill `rgba(18, 15, 14, 0.72)` coupled with `backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(120%)`. Used for sticky booking navigation bars and modal overlays to maintain awareness of underlying tattoo photography.
- **Atmospheric Amber Vignette:** Soft linear gradients (`radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%)`) subtly cast warmth behind artist spotlight banners.

### 3. Edge Illumination & Outlines
- Shadows are minimal and warm: `0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)` paired with an inner top hairline highlight (`box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15)`) mimicking direct studio spotlighting on fine metalwork.

## Shapes

The design system adopts a soft, architectural corner geometry (`roundedness: 1`). Corners are subtly attenuated (4px base, 8px on cards, 12px on overlay dialogs) to echo museum plinths, high-end perfume cases, and precision surgical instrument trays.

- **Interactive Triggers (Buttons/Inputs):** `4px` corner radii. Sharp enough to feel editorial and tailored; soft enough to prevent harshness on handheld devices.
- **Cards & Media Frames:** `8px` corner radii with mandatory `overflow: hidden` to frame high-resolution tattoo details cleanly.
- **Floating Modals & Sheets:** `12px` top corners on mobile sliding sheets.
- **Pills / Status Badges:** Pure circular radii (`9999px`) applied strictly to micro-status indicators (e.g., "Available This Month", "Guest Artist").

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Deposit / Confirm Session):** Solid gold base (`#D4AF37`) with obsidian typography (`#0D0C0B`), font weight `600`, subtle letter spacing (`0.04em`). On hover, soft gold glow (`box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35)`).
- **Secondary Action (Explore Works / View Bio):** Smoked cocoa surface (`#1E1A17`) with hairline bronze border (`#9B7E58` at 40%), text in `#F6F4F0`.
- **Text / Ghost Button:** Transparent background, ivory text, decorated with an animated underline starting from the center outward.

### Chips & Badges
- **Artist Specialties (e.g., "Fine Line", "Micro-Portraiture"):** Minimalist hairline containers (`border: 1px solid #2E2824`) with muted stone text (`#A39E98`), transforming to `#D4AF37` text and border when selected.
- **Availability Badges:** Pill-shaped, dark cocoa background (`#221A15`), containing a 6px glowing status dot (emerald for open books, muted gold for waitlist).

### Booking Date & Slot Picker
- Grid of calendar dates styled as clean numerical blocks.
- Unavailable slots: `#141211` background, `#423C37` struck-through text.
- Selected slot: Deep cocoa background bordered by active gold highlight (`#D4AF37`), with instant summary feedback below.

### Cards & Artist Portfolio Tiles
- **Portfolio Showcase Card:** Full-bleed portrait image ratio (3:4 or 4:5), overlaying a bottom gradient (`from transparent to #0D0C0B 90%`). Artist name rendered in `Playfair Display`, specialty category in tracked uppercase `Outfit`.
- **Consultation Estimate Card:** Contained within elevated level 1 surface (`#141211`), split by fine bronze keylines detailing session hours, prep requirements, deposit threshold, and studio hygiene certifications.

### Inputs & Form Fields
- Understated architectural inputs: Solid dark fill (`#151312`) with 1px baseline or border (`#2B2521`).
- Focus state: Border shifts to brushed brass (`#9B7E58`), label text animates upward in small-caps.
- Error state: Burnt sienna border (`#C2412D`) with clear, calming feedback text.

### Radio & Checkbox Selectors
- Bespoke custom geometries: 18px square with 2px radius. In active state, filled with obsidian and bordered by `#D4AF37`, housing an engraved gold checkmark or inner square.
